name: Control Flames
description:
Exercise an amount of control over the natural element of fire. Choose a point you can see within range:
- Instantaneously expand an existing flame 5 ft. in one direction, provided fuel is present in the new direction
- Instantaneously extinguish flames within a 5 ft. cube
- Change the color, brightness, or cause simple shapes to appear in an existing flame for 1 hour
- Create a magical flame, either held by you or on the ground that you can see within range for 1 hour. If the flame is on the ground, any creature that enters its space for the first time on its turn or ends its turn there must succeed a Reflex saving throw, taking 1d8 fire damage on a failure.

**At Higher Levels.** The spell's damage increases by 1d8 when you reach 5th level (2d8), 11th level (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).
